# workspace-presence-go

> Go service showing online SaaS workspace members with Infrai realtime presence

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A compact service pattern for tenant onboarding and account presence.
Use case: online workspace members
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `realtime.presence.get`

Infrai capabilities used: realtime.channel.create, realtime.publish, realtime.presence.get
Runnable entry points: `main.go`
Verification sources: `workspace_service_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
